about: Cases both analysis engines must pass: server/src/analysis (Rust) and ui/src/analysis (TypeScript). Numbers compare with a relative tolerance of 1e-9; everything else exactly. A step case gives its inputs by refId (in the order of the refIds sorted), lists the fields to check per frame and, with names, the full field order; outputOrder is the order of the frames after the steps. An input may name a graph (graphs); expectGraphs gives the node and edge ids and the schema of a graph the steps leave. An expression case with a calendar runs in that time zone (UTC when absent) and with that first day of the week (monday when absent).
